purpose: Actual native-input movement investigation. This analyzer reports complete action ordering, per-tick angular/contact/steering evidence and review candidates. It never substitutes eventual upright state or test pass counts for human handling assessment.
limitations: Prepared initial poses do not establish an independently driven approach or normal-menu kickoff.
Controller and physical Chromebook coverage must be stated separately by the operator.
Diagnostic camera follows translation with a fixed world offset; normal car/ball cameras use unchanged production code.
Candidate drive-pitch and velocity-cutoff events require review; a genuine wall departure or aerial input may be correct.
Native event scheduling is not guaranteed identical across runs; automated source probes provide exact tick schedule comparisons.
Trace instrumentation adds work; these runs do not establish production FPS or input latency.
